notes: User is planning a relaxed beach trip with friends and has narrowed the destination to Fort Myers Beach, Florida, about 2.5 hours from Tampa. They especially like paddleboarding and calm Gulf waters; suggested launch areas include Matanzas Pass, Bowditch Point Regional Park, and Estero Bay. They are leaning toward staying at The Outrigger Beach Resort and want a beach-view or beachfront room, though dates, budget, group size, and room preferences remain unknown. When booking, they should verify that the exact property is The Outrigger Fort Myers Beach and confirm current room categories, views, fees, and amenities; a request alone does not guarantee a view. Potential nearby activities include Sanibel Island and J.N. Ding Darling National Wildlife Refuge, Fort Myers River District and Edison/Ford Winter Estates, Cayo Costa State Park, shelling tours, dolphin-watching, kayaking, and other water sports. Rachel previously moved to the suburbs; her precise location and the trip dates are still unknown, so day-trip logistics may need adjustment. Colorado hiking remains a possible alternative, but Florida now appears to be the leading choice.
